title: Google sign-in handoff
summary: Google sign-in can now navigate to Google's authorization page.
highlights: The browser form destination policy permits Google's authorization origin only when Google sign-in is configured.

title: Google sign-in route
summary: Google sign-in submits to the correct account endpoint.
highlights: The login form uses the root-relative external authentication route.

title: Clearer loading updates
summary: Loading updates now say what OpenWish is working on.
highlights: Screen readers receive contextual loading updates without duplicate announcements from decorative button spinners.

title: Clearer product links
summary: Product links now make it clearer where they lead.
highlights: Wishlist product links identify the item they open for screen-reader users and safely open in a new tab.

title: Sustainable improvements
summary: A stronger foundation for consistent product updates and verified releases.
highlights: Release highlights are now available directly in OpenWish.
Wishlist, event, and friend pages share a clearer visual hierarchy.
Browser verification covers owner, guest, and friend journeys across desktop and mobile layouts.
A verified walkthrough demonstrates wishlists, events, gift exchange, friends, notifications, and responsive use.
An isolated agent-managed environment can be promoted without changing the developer's Aspire data or ports.
Private social, event, notification, activity, and reservation data is now protected by stricter authorization and privacy controls.
Self-hosted deployments now include safer login, proxy, browser, email, and product-link defaults.
Google sign-in now recovers unconfirmed linked accounts through email confirmation instead of asking users to link again.
Notification deletion now updates immediately and reports failures instead of closing without feedback.
Creation forms now focus their first useful field, and wishlists include a compact icon picker.
Invitation registration now clearly keeps the email address that received the invitation.
Wishlist collaboration actions now consistently use the signed-in user's identity.
Local time formatting is safer and accurate across partial-hour time zones.
